report-generation v1.0.0

- Initial release of the report-generation skill.
- Generates verifiable metrics, charts, explanations, and multi-format reports from CSV/XLSX files.
- Ensures explanations only reference verified metrics; inconsistency in values blocks model interpretations.
- Supports export to Markdown, XLSX, PNG, and PDF.
- Requires configuration of an API key, with installation and usage instructions provided.
- Focuses on deterministic outputs with clear separation between confirmed and model-generated content.
